messages:
Jenna (CS): kicking off the next wave of the vanguard beta — need a quick agree on scope and feedback cadence. quick yes/no if you can join sync today at 3pm PT.
Liam (AM): can do 3pm, but heads-up: NovaCorp renewal flagged low usage. should we prioritize them in wave 2?
Sophia (PM): agree on prioritizing NovaCorp. their feature requests could influence the next patch. also want to run a 20-min product demo during onboarding call.
Devon (Eng): FYI we pushed a small fix for prompt truncation yesterday — staging looks stable. if NovaCorp sees that, should help their infra errors.
Marta (CSE): I can run 2 customer calls this week (Tue AM & Thu PM). can take Arcadia and NovaCorp if we confirm.
Jenna (CS): perfect. proposed cadence: 1) onboarding + demo call 2) 1-week usage check 3) 3-week qualitative interview. want to capture both quantitative telemetry and a short NPS-ish question.
Sophia (PM): +1. add one targeted question about latency/cost perception. that maps to our Optimize telemetry.
Liam (AM): adding renewal note — NovaCorp's contract auto-renews in 9 weeks. if adoption doesn't lift we need an enablement plan before legal cycle.
Jenna (CS): noted. action items: Jenna to schedule calls, Marta to run onboarding, Devon to verify fix is in prod for NovaCorp, Sophia to draft 3 interview questions.
Marta (CSE): I created a short intake sheet: https://docs.google.com/... (share restricted) — please add customer-specific asks.
Devon (Eng): @Jenna pushed the hotfix to a canary pool. I'll paste the canary link in the notes after deploy.
beta-bot: Reminder: beta cohort capacity at 80% for dedicated pool — autoscale will trigger additional nodes at 85% load.
Jenna (CS): thanks — can everyone update that sheet by EOD? I'll send calendar invites after.
Liam (AM): will add NovaCorp usage notes and key POC contact.
Sophia (PM): drafting the interview scripts now, will post in the doc.
Marta (CSE): FYI — suggested empathy line for calls: "we want to make the model useful for your specific workflows" — short and explicit.
Jenna (CS): love that. one more ask: volunteers for taking notes during interviews? recording + anonymized notes for product.
Liam (AM): I can take notes for NovaCorp.
Devon (Eng): I can join one call as technical backup Thu.
Jenna (CS): great — ok final check: scheduling today @3pm PT then send invites. if no objections by 2:45pm I'll proceed. :thumbsup:
Sophia (PM): thumbs.
Marta (CSE): :+1:
Jenna (CS): (closing) thanks team — will follow up with calendar + doc link.
